title: Check idealism against neuroimaging of impaired and dissociated states

statements.text: The checkable consequences lie in neuroimaging: states of reduced or impaired brain function should accompany richer experience, and dissociation should have a distinct measurable appearance. Systematic research into the pattern should continue.

sources.quote: this paper suggests that an as-of-yet unrecognized causal principle underlying the entire pattern might be at work, whose further elucidation through systematic research could hold great promise.
